Title: QueuedInput - Chat Input Queue Item
Summary: Represents a single queued chat input message with role, content, and optional additional content items. Used by the iteration queue system.
Content:
## QueuedInput

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Models`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Represents a single item in the chat input queue. Contains the message role, text content, and any additional content items (files, images, etc.).

### Constructor
```csharp
public QueuedInput(AuthorRole role, string? content, AdditionalMessageContent[]? items)
```
- `role`: The message author role (User, Assistant, System, etc.)
- `content`: The text content of the message
- `items`: Optional additional content items (images, files, etc.)
- Automatically generates a GUID `Id`

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Id` | `string` | Unique identifier (GUID, read-only) |
| `Role` | `AuthorRole` | The message author role (read-only) |
| `Content` | `string` | The text content (required, defaults to empty string if null) |
| `Items` | `List<AdditionalMessageContent>` | Additional content items (images, files, etc.) |

### Usage
```csharp
var input = new QueuedInput(AuthorRole.User, "Hello, analyze this image", new[]
{
    new AdditionalMessageContent("image.png", new ImageContent(imageBytes, "image/png"))
});

// Access properties
Console.WriteLine(input.Id);      // "a1b2c3d4-..."
Console.WriteLine(input.Role);    // User
Console.WriteLine(input.Content); // "Hello, analyze this image"
```

### Related
- `IIterationService` - Processes queued inputs
- `AdditionalMessageContent` - Wrapper for additional content items
- `AuthorRole` - Semantic Kernel role enumeration
